summary:
Implementation plan to transform the website from a live-agent testing playground into a premium AI Voice Agent service landing page.
- Completely removes the public live testing interface, microphone permissions, audio visualizer/feedback loops, and VoiceAgentConsole testing playground.
- Redesigns Hero section with modern glowing voice orb illustration, exact headlines, primary WhatsApp CTA (+92 310 6449454), and secondary 'How It Works' scroll CTA.
- Adds 'Your AI Receptionist. Your Business Rules.' 4-card capability section replacing the old interactive console.
- Updates How It Works into an elegant 4-step personalized demo workflow.
- Implements prominent 'See What an AI Voice Agent Could Do for Your Business' Free Demo CTA section with pre-filled WhatsApp click-to-chat.
- Refines Business Use Cases covering 7 key industries with practical applications.
- Retains Solution Finder and positions Website Development as a clean secondary service.
- Ensures honest claims, full responsive testing, and zero microphone/audio bugs.
